title: AutoNation Announces Fourth Quarter 2025 Earnings Conference Call and Audio Webcast Scheduled for Friday, February 6, 2026
summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN), today announced that it will release its financial results for the fourth quarter ended December 31, 2025, on Friday, February 6, 2026, before the market opens. AutoNation management will discuss these results and other information regarding the Company during a conference call and audio webcast that same day at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The conference call may be accessed by telephone at 833-470-1428 (Conference ID: 817116) or on AutoNation’s investor relations website at investors.autonation.com . The webcast will also be available on AutoNation’s website following the call under “Events Presentations” after 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on February 6, 2026, through 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on Friday, February 27, 2026, or by calling 866-813-9403 (Conference ID: 180735).
